tool.name: ART 454
tool.help:
Art 454 Pyrosequencing Simulator ================================
ART_454 is a simulation program to generate sequence read data of Roche 454 Pyrosequencing sequencers. ART generates reads according to the empirical read quality profile and the calibrated error profile of uncall/overcall homopolymers from real 454 read data. ART has been using for testing or benchmarking a variety of method or tools for next-generation sequencing data analysis, including read alignment, de novo assembly, detection of SNP, CNV, or other structure variation.
- art art_src_MountRainier_Linux/ART_profiler_454/README: art_profiler_454 is the tool to generate a 454 read profile from 454 sequencing data in the fastq format. USAGE: ./art_profiler_454 input_fastq_files_dir output_profile_dir [fastq_filename_extension] PARAMETERS input_fastq_files_dir - directory containing all 454 read data files in the fastq format output_profile_dir - directory to put read profile files generated by the program art_454 can generate both single-end and paired-end of 454 sequencing platform. Besides for regular genome DNA and cDNA sequencing simulation, art_454 also supports amplicon sequencing. The reference sequences can be either DNA or RNA.
